inbox.body_features: Mod da duoc cap nhat. Xem trang du an de biet chi tiet.
inbox.body_features.v1.0.15:
Co gi moi:
• Nang tuong thich len Sky 0.33.2 (384474).
• API Collect: da them nen o Wonderland Cafe.
• Du lieu huan luyen gio duoc cap nhat qua mang; khong can ban phat hanh moi cho cac bo sung trong tuong lai.
inbox.body_features.v1.0.16:
Co gi moi:
• Hanh dong xa hoi: Nhan qua, Thap sao, Gui tim. Tu dong dua vao Collect All.
• Quan ly muc tieu tim: danh sach rieng cho moi tai khoan, co Luu/Bo.
inbox.body_features.v1.0.17:
Co gi moi:
• Trinh phat nhac: tai ban nhac, bam Play - khong can nghi thuc hieu chinh 15 phim.
• Ve su kien: nut 'thu thap' chi la gia duoc suot thoi gian qua. Xin loi. Da sua. Gio that su thu thap.
• Props: dat o bat cu dau, bo qua cooldown hanh dong.
inbox.body_features.v1.0.18:
Co gi moi:
• Nang tuong thich len Sky 0.33.5 (390271).
inbox.body_features.v1.0.19: Da sua: cay bong toi, nhap nhieu ban nhac, luu Chong AFK va noi dung changelog.
inbox.body_features.v1.0.20: 200 diem dich chuyen giup farm nhom de tho, them tim kiem ban do & tu dong cap nhat. Chia se cac diem OOB yeu thich cua ban tren Github!
inbox.body_features.v1.0.21: Nhap nhac gio chap nhan ban nhac UTF-16 va ma hoa cua Sky Studio truoc day bi loi.
inbox.body_ps: PS: yen tam, hop thu cua ban khong bi am - tin nhan nay chi co trong mod, TGC khong he biet 😇
